features:

Copy the script.

Paste it into your executor.

Verify on Discord (instructions in the script).

Enjoy!

✨ Main Features:

🎯 Combat & Aimbot

Aimbot: Extremely smooth, mouse-movement-based aimbot (undetectable).

Sticky Aim: Locks perfectly onto targets without snapping randomly.

Target Selection: Choose between Head or Chest aiming.

TriggerBot: Auto-fires instantly when an enemy enters your crosshair (Customizable Delay & FOV).

Gun Mods (Memory Hooking):

No Recoil: Removes all weapon kickback.

No Spread: 100% accuracy, every single shot hits dead center.

Instant Reload: Skips reload animations entirely.

Hitbox Expander: Expand enemy hitboxes to never miss a shot (Size & Transparency settings).

👁️ Visuals & ESP

Box & Name ESP: Clean player boxes and nametags.

Health & Distance: Dynamic health bars responding to player HP and distance trackers.

Chams: Red overlay on enemy characters making them pop out from the environment.

FOV Circles: Visual indicators for Aimbot and Triggerbot zones.

🏃‍♂️ Movement

Custom WalkSpeed: Force your speed up to 200.

Noclip: Walk through walls (toggleable via keybind).
